entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. You're speaking with Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I think I need to make a return? I got this helmet a couple of days ago, but I'm just so confused by the whole process. I don't know what to do.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, it's not broken. The box unopened is still right here. It's just... the color. It looked so different on the website, and now that I have it, I'm not sure. It's all a bit much. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. I completely understand that the color can sometimes look different in person. And I'm glad to hear it isn't a safety issue or a problem with the helmet itself.
Right, it's just the color. So, what can I do? I'm so lost.

Not to worry, you're well within the return period. Since it's a helmet, you have a 90-day window for returns, and you received it just two days ago. We can absolutely get this returned for a full refund for you.
Oh, thank goodness. That's a huge relief. That's great. What do I need to do next?

It's a very simple process. I've just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to the address we have on file for you. All you need to do is print that label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be processed automatically.
Okay, a label in my email. I can do that. Thank you so much for making it easy, Sarah.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again for your help.
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
